/* Resumen ejecutivo del panel gerencial: doble lectura HOY / MES ACUMULADO. "Hoy" lo define el servidor (los timestamps se guardan en hora local naive y la base corre en UTC). */
WITH rr AS (
  SELECT hoy, sede, mon,
         date_trunc('month', hoy)::date AS mes_ini,
         (hoy - 7) AS dia_ant,
         (date_trunc('month', hoy) - interval '1 month')::date AS mes_ant_ini,
         ((date_trunc('month', hoy) - interval '1 month')::date
           + (hoy - date_trunc('month', hoy)::date)) AS mes_ant_fin
  FROM (
    /* ref_date solo se informa para pruebas y reprocesos; en uso normal viene vacio y manda el servidor. */
    SELECT COALESCE($3::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Montevideo')::date) AS hoy,
           $1::int AS sede,
           COALESCE($2::varchar, 'UYU') AS mon
  ) r
),
/* Produccion = facturado por fecha de factura. La sede sale de la heuristica de cita mas cercana (100% de cobertura, ~1,2% de error) porque invoices.sede_id esta vacio. */
inv AS (
  SELECT i.created_at::date AS fecha, i.total, est.sede_id
  FROM invoices i
  CROSS JOIN rr
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cs.sede_id
    FROM appointments a
    JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
    WHERE a.patient_id = i.user_id AND cs.sede_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.start_datetime - i.created_at)))
    LIMIT 1
  ) est ON true
  WHERE i.is_sales = true AND i.currency = rr.mon
    AND i.created_at::date BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.hoy
    AND (rr.sede IS NULL OR est.sede_id = rr.sede)
),
/* Cobranza: payments no tiene ninguna via a la sede (cash_session_id esta al 0%), asi que siempre es consolidada. El nodo Code lo declara con disponible_por_sede=false. */
pay AS (
  SELECT p.created_at::date AS fecha, p.amount
  FROM payments p CROSS JOIN rr
  WHERE p.is_sales = true AND p.currency = rr.mon
    AND p.created_at::date BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.hoy
),
/* Gastos: miscellaneous_transactions no tiene columna de sede. gas_filas permite distinguir "sin datos cargados" de "cero", que es la diferencia que pide CA-10. */
gas AS (
  SELECT mt.transaction_date AS fecha, mt.amount
  FROM miscellaneous_transactions mt CROSS JOIN rr
  WHERE mt.currency = rr.mon
    AND mt.transaction_date BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.hoy
),
cit AS (
  SELECT a.start_datetime::date AS fecha, a.patient_id, a.status
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
  CROSS JOIN rr
  WHERE a.start_datetime::date BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.hoy
    AND (rr.sede IS NULL OR cs.sede_id = rr.sede)
),
nue AS (
  /* Paciente nuevo = fecha de su primera cita atendida de la historia. NO se usa users.created_at: esa columna refleja la fecha de importacion (14.796 de las 14.979 fichas se crearon de golpe en julio 2026), no el alta real del paciente. */
  SELECT f.primera AS fecha
  FROM (
    SELECT a.patient_id, min(a.start_datetime::date) AS primera
    FROM appointments a
    WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')
    GROUP BY a.patient_id
  ) f
  CROSS JOIN rr
  WHERE f.primera BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.hoy
)
SELECT
  rr.hoy AS fecha_servidor,
  rr.sede AS sede_id,
  rr.mon AS currency,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM inv WHERE fecha = rr.hoy) AS prod_hoy,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM inv WHERE fecha = rr.dia_ant) AS prod_dia_ant,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM inv WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ini AND rr.hoy) AS prod_mes,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM inv WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.mes_ant_fin) AS prod_mes_ant,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM pay WHERE fecha = rr.hoy) AS cob_hoy,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM pay WHERE fecha = rr.dia_ant) AS cob_dia_ant,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM pay WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ini AND rr.hoy) AS cob_mes,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM pay WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.mes_ant_fin) AS cob_mes_ant,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gas) AS gas_filas,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM gas WHERE fecha = rr.hoy) AS gas_hoy,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM gas WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ini AND rr.hoy) AS gas_mes,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM cit
     WHERE fecha = rr.hoy AND status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS pac_hoy,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM cit
     WHERE fecha = rr.dia_ant AND status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS pac_dia_ant,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM cit
     WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ini AND rr.hoy
       AND status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS pac_mes,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM cit
     WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.mes_ant_fin
       AND status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS pac_mes_ant,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cit WHERE fecha = rr.hoy) AS agendados_hoy,
  /* Atenciones: cuenta citas atendidas, no personas. A diferencia de los pacientes unicos, es aditiva: la suma de los dias da el total del mes. */
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cit
     WHERE fecha = rr.hoy AND status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS at_hoy,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cit
     WHERE fecha = rr.dia_ant AND status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS at_dia_ant,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cit
     WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ini AND rr.hoy
       AND status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS at_mes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cit
     WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.mes_ant_fin
       AND status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS at_mes_ant,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nue WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ini AND rr.hoy) AS nue_mes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nue WHERE fecha BETWEEN rr.mes_ant_ini AND rr.mes_ant_fin) AS nue_mes_ant
FROM rr;

/* Produccion, pacientes y no-show por sucursal. Una fila por sede activa (tambien las que no facturaron, para que el gerente vea el cero en vez de una sede ausente). */
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::date AS df, $2::date AS dt, COALESCE($3::varchar,'UYU') AS mon
),
inv AS (
  SELECT i.total, est.sede_id
  FROM invoices i
  CROSS JOIN p
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cs.sede_id
    FROM appointments a
    JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
    WHERE a.patient_id = i.user_id AND cs.sede_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.start_datetime - i.created_at)))
    LIMIT 1
  ) est ON true
  WHERE i.is_sales = true AND i.currency = p.mon
    AND i.created_at::date BETWEEN p.df AND p.dt
),
ag AS (
  SELECT cs.sede_id,
         count(DISTINCT a.patient_id)
           FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS pacientes,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')) AS atenciones,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'no_show') AS no_show
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE a.start_datetime::date BETWEEN p.df AND p.dt
  GROUP BY 1
),
agg AS (
  SELECT s.id AS sede_id, s.name,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total) FROM inv WHERE inv.sede_id = s.id), 0) AS produccion,
         COALESCE(ag.pacientes, 0) AS pacientes,
         COALESCE(ag.atenciones, 0) AS atenciones,
         COALESCE(ag.no_show, 0) AS no_show
  FROM sedes s
  LEFT JOIN ag ON ag.sede_id = s.id
  WHERE s.is_active
)
SELECT sede_id, name, produccion, pacientes, atenciones, no_show,
       CASE WHEN pacientes > 0 THEN ROUND(produccion / pacientes, 0) END AS ticket_promedio,
       ROUND(100.0 * produccion / NULLIF(SUM(produccion) OVER (), 0), 1) AS pct
FROM agg
ORDER BY produccion DESC;

/* Serie de pacientes unicos atendidos, con la granularidad adaptada al ancho del periodo: con un rango de varios meses, 300 barras diarias son ilegibles y el eje X repite los mismos numeros de dia una vez por mes.  La agregacion se hace aca y no en el frontend por una razon de correctitud: los pacientes unicos de una semana NO son la suma de los unicos de cada dia. Quien viene el lunes y el jueves cuenta una sola vez en la semana, pero dos si se suman los dias. */
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::date AS df,
         $2::date AS dt,
         $3::int AS sede,
         COALESCE($5::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Montevideo')::date) AS hoy,
         COALESCE(
           NULLIF($4::varchar, ''),
           CASE
             WHEN $2::date - $1::date <= 62  THEN 'day'
             WHEN $2::date - $1::date <= 180 THEN 'week'
             ELSE 'month'
           END
         ) AS gran
),
step AS (
  SELECT p.*,
         CASE p.gran
           WHEN 'day'  THEN interval '1 day'
           WHEN 'week' THEN interval '1 week'
           ELSE interval '1 month'
         END AS paso,
         /* Las semanas y los meses arrancan en su limite natural, aunque el rango empiece a mitad; el primer bucket se recorta despues para no mostrar dias fuera del filtro. */
         CASE p.gran
           WHEN 'day'  THEN p.df
           WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week', p.df)::date
           ELSE date_trunc('month', p.df)::date
         END AS primer_bucket
  FROM p
),
bucket AS (
  SELECT s.gran, s.sede, s.hoy, s.df, s.dt, s.paso,
         generate_series(s.primer_bucket, s.dt, s.paso)::date AS ini
  FROM step s
),
rango AS (
  SELECT gran, sede, hoy,
         GREATEST(ini, df) AS fecha_inicio,
         LEAST((ini + paso - interval '1 day')::date, dt) AS fecha_fin
  FROM bucket
),
pri AS (
  SELECT a.patient_id, min(a.start_datetime::date) AS primera
  FROM appointments a
  WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')
  GROUP BY a.patient_id
)
SELECT r.gran AS granularity,
       r.fecha_inicio,
       r.fecha_fin,
       x.pacientes,
       x.nuevos,
       x.pacientes - x.nuevos AS recurrentes,
       x.atenciones,
       x.atenciones_nuevos,
       x.atenciones - x.atenciones_nuevos AS atenciones_recurrentes,
       (r.hoy BETWEEN r.fecha_inicio AND r.fecha_fin) AS es_actual
FROM rango r
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  /* "nuevo" es primera visita EN LA CLINICA, no en la sede: con el filtro de sucursal puesto, quien debuto en otra sede cuenta como recurrente. */
  SELECT count(DISTINCT a.patient_id) AS pacientes,
         count(DISTINCT a.patient_id) FILTER (
           WHERE pri.primera BETWEEN r.fecha_inicio AND r.fecha_fin
         ) AS nuevos,
         /* Atenciones: citas, no personas. Es la serie aditiva del grafico; la suma de los buckets da el total del periodo, cosa que los pacientes unicos no cumplen. */
         count(*) AS atenciones,
         count(*) FILTER (
           WHERE pri.primera BETWEEN r.fecha_inicio AND r.fecha_fin
         ) AS atenciones_nuevos
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
  /* LEFT y no JOIN: hay 12 citas atendidas en la historia sin paciente asignado. Con un JOIN se caian de las atenciones y el grafico sumaba uno menos que la tarjeta del mes. Sin paciente no pueden ser primera visita, asi que caen del lado de recurrentes. */
  LEFT JOIN pri ON pri.patient_id = a.patient_id
  WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')
    AND a.start_datetime::date BETWEEN r.fecha_inicio AND r.fecha_fin
    AND (r.sede IS NULL OR cs.sede_id = r.sede)
) x ON true
ORDER BY r.fecha_inicio;

/* Ventas por servicio. Se agrupa por nombre de servicio y no por service_catalog.specialty porque specialty esta vacio en los ~381 servicios 'single' (98,4% de la facturacion caeria en "sin clasificar"). El total del periodo se devuelve aparte para calcular el porcentaje sobre el total real y no sobre la suma del top N. */
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::date AS df, $2::date AS dt, $3::int AS sede,
         COALESCE($4::varchar,'UYU') AS mon, COALESCE($5::int, 6) AS lim
),
items AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(sc.name, 'Sin servicio') AS name, ii.total
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN invoices i ON i.id = ii.invoice_id AND i.is_sales = true
  LEFT JOIN service_catalog sc ON sc.id = ii.service_id
  CROSS JOIN p
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cs.sede_id
    FROM appointments a
    JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
    WHERE a.patient_id = i.user_id AND cs.sede_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.start_datetime - i.created_at)))
    LIMIT 1
  ) est ON true
  WHERE i.currency = p.mon
    AND i.created_at::date BETWEEN p.df AND p.dt
    AND (p.sede IS NULL OR est.sede_id = p.sede)
)
SELECT name,
       SUM(total) AS sales,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM items) AS total_periodo
FROM items
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT (SELECT lim FROM p);

/* Evolucion mensual de todas las metricas del panel, para responder "como venimos de un mes a otro" sin tener que ir cambiando el filtro de periodo.  El ultimo mes casi siempre esta en curso, asi que se recorta a la fecha de referencia y se marca como parcial. Para que su variacion no compare 20 dias contra 30, ademas se calcula el mes anterior truncado al mismo dia (anterior_alineado), el mismo criterio de mes_ant_fin que usa el resumen ejecutivo. */
WITH p AS (
  SELECT COALESCE($4::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Montevideo')::date) AS ref,
         $1::int AS sede,
         COALESCE($2::varchar, 'UYU') AS mon,
         GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE($3::int, 6), 24), 2) AS meses
),
m AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
           date_trunc('month', p.ref) - ((p.meses - 1) || ' month')::interval,
           date_trunc('month', p.ref),
           '1 month')::date AS ini,
         p.sede, p.mon, p.ref
  FROM p
),
r AS (
  SELECT ini, sede, mon, ref,
         LEAST((ini + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date, ref) AS fin,
         (ini + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date > ref AS es_parcial,
         /* Mismo tramo de dias en el mes anterior, para comparar peras con peras. */
         (ini - interval '1 month')::date AS ant_ini,
         ((ini - interval '1 month')::date + (LEAST((ini + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date, ref) - ini)) AS ant_fin
  FROM m
),
pri AS (
  SELECT a.patient_id, min(a.start_datetime::date) AS primera
  FROM appointments a
  WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')
  GROUP BY a.patient_id
)
SELECT
  to_char(r.ini, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes,
  r.ini AS mes_inicio,
  r.fin AS mes_fin,
  r.es_parcial,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total), 0) FROM invoices i
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT cs.sede_id FROM appointments a
     JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
     WHERE a.patient_id = i.user_id AND cs.sede_id IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.start_datetime - i.created_at))) LIMIT 1
   ) est ON true
   WHERE i.is_sales AND i.currency = r.mon
     AND i.created_at::date BETWEEN r.ini AND r.fin
     AND (r.sede IS NULL OR est.sede_id = r.sede))                                AS produccion,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount), 0) FROM payments pa
   WHERE pa.is_sales AND pa.currency = r.mon
     AND pa.created_at::date BETWEEN r.ini AND r.fin)                             AS cobranza,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) FROM appointments a
   JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
   WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')
     AND a.start_datetime::date BETWEEN r.ini AND r.fin
     AND (r.sede IS NULL OR cs.sede_id = r.sede))                                 AS pacientes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments a
   JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
   WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')
     AND a.start_datetime::date BETWEEN r.ini AND r.fin
     AND (r.sede IS NULL OR cs.sede_id = r.sede))                                 AS atenciones,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pri WHERE pri.primera BETWEEN r.ini AND r.fin)            AS nuevos,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM miscellaneous_transactions mt
   WHERE mt.currency = r.mon AND mt.transaction_date BETWEEN r.ini AND r.fin)     AS gastos_filas,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mt.amount), 0) FROM miscellaneous_transactions mt
   WHERE mt.currency = r.mon AND mt.transaction_date BETWEEN r.ini AND r.fin)     AS gastos,
  /* Solo se usa cuando el mes esta en curso. */
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total), 0) FROM invoices i
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT cs.sede_id FROM appointments a
     JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
     WHERE a.patient_id = i.user_id AND cs.sede_id IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.start_datetime - i.created_at))) LIMIT 1
   ) est ON true
   WHERE i.is_sales AND i.currency = r.mon
     AND i.created_at::date BETWEEN r.ant_ini AND r.ant_fin
     AND (r.sede IS NULL OR est.sede_id = r.sede))                                AS produccion_ant_alineada,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount), 0) FROM payments pa
   WHERE pa.is_sales AND pa.currency = r.mon
     AND pa.created_at::date BETWEEN r.ant_ini AND r.ant_fin)                     AS cobranza_ant_alineada,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) FROM appointments a
   JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
   WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')
     AND a.start_datetime::date BETWEEN r.ant_ini AND r.ant_fin
     AND (r.sede IS NULL OR cs.sede_id = r.sede))                                 AS pacientes_ant_alineada,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments a
   JOIN calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
   WHERE a.status IN ('completed','attended_late','arrived_late')
     AND a.start_datetime::date BETWEEN r.ant_ini AND r.ant_fin
     AND (r.sede IS NULL OR cs.sede_id = r.sede))                                 AS atenciones_ant_alineada,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pri WHERE pri.primera BETWEEN r.ant_ini AND r.ant_fin)    AS nuevos_ant_alineada,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mt.amount), 0) FROM miscellaneous_transactions mt
   WHERE mt.currency = r.mon AND mt.transaction_date BETWEEN r.ant_ini AND r.ant_fin) AS gastos_ant_alineada
FROM r
ORDER BY r.ini;
